root = Stack([header, summary, tabs, tableHeader, dataTable])

header = TextContent("Checkout A/B Test Results", "large-heavy")

summary = Callout("success", "Recommendation: Ship Variant D (Express Pay First)", "Variant D achieved the highest conversion rate (3.9%) and the lowest bounce rate (35%). Although Average Order Value (AOV) dropped slightly to $49, the 25% relative increase in conversion over Control typically generates higher overall revenue. Consider running a follow-up test combining Variant D's express pay with Variant C's trust badges to recover AOV.")

tabs = Tabs([tabConv, tabAOV, tabBounce])

tabConv = TabItem("conv", "Conversion Rate", [convCard])
convCard = Card([convChart], "card")
convChart = BarChart(variants, [convSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Conversion Rate (%)")

tabAOV = TabItem("aov", "Average Order Value", [aovCard])
aovCard = Card([aovChart], "card")
aovChart = BarChart(variants, [aovSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "AOV ($)")

tabBounce = TabItem("bounce", "Bounce Rate", [bounceCard])
bounceCard = Card([bounceChart], "card")
bounceChart = BarChart(variants, [bounceSeries], "grouped", "Variant", "Bounce Rate (%)")

variants = ["A (Control)", "B (One-page)", "C (Trust Badges)", "D (Express Pay)"]
convSeries = Series("Conversion (%)", [3.1, 3.6, 3.3, 3.9])
aovSeries = Series("AOV ($)", [54, 51, 56, 49])
bounceSeries = Series("Bounce Rate (%)", [41, 37, 40, 35])

tableHeader = InlineHeader("Detailed Metrics", "Based on ~12,000 sessions per variant over two weeks.")

dataTable = Table([colVariant, colConv, colAOV, colBounce])
colVariant = Col("Variant", variants)
colConv = Col("Conversion Rate", ["3.1%", "3.6%", "3.3%", "3.9%"])
colAOV = Col("Avg Order Value", ["$54.00", "$51.00", "$56.00", "$49.00"])
colBounce = Col("Bounce Rate", ["41%", "37%", "40%", "35%"])
